skills.name: Scattered Paper (花紙散)
skills.line: Wee choo, stay away from me!
skills.description: Kawazaru throws paper sprinkles to attack a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Monkey Business (猿形華露)
skills.line: Oops, I used all the paper.
skills.description: This skill unlocks when Kawazaru can no longer changes forms. Using normal attacks also decreases the enemy's RES by 10%, lasts for 2 turns.

upgrades.text: Normal attacks also inflict 20% of Vulnerability.

skills.name: Shapeshifting Mastery (変幻自在)
skills.description: Kawazaru has many faces and can spend Transformation Paper to change her form. After completing a transformation, she gains a Paper Shield that can adsorb damage equal to 15% of her max HP. Her current form ends when the Paper Shield fails or she transforms again. ;Upon Usage :Kawazaru transform, then unlocks and uses one of the following skills: You're Evil!, Stop Chasing Me! and I'd Better Hide!. ;Kaleidoscope Paper (百花紙) : :'''Debuff, Status''': At the end of turn, deals indirect damage equal to 140% of Kawazaru's ATK. ;Transformation Paper (変身花紙) :Kawazaru is granted 3 layers of Transformation Paper the start of battle. Each transformation costs 1 Paper. Kawazaru loses the ability to transforms when she has 0 Transformation Papers. ;Paper Shield (花紙盾) : :A shield that is created when Kawazaru transforms, it absorbs a certain amount of damage and cannot be dispelled.

upgrades.text: '''You're Evil!''': Also deals damage equal to 180% of Kawazaru's ATK.
'''Stop Chasing Me!''': Also inflicts the target with Kaleidoscope Paper (lasts for 1 turn).
'''I'd Better Hide!''': Also restores the HP of all allies by 31% of Kawazaru's ATK.

skills.name: You're Evil! (あなたは悪者です)
skills.description: Kawazaru emits a puzzling cloud towards a single enemy and has an 80% base chance of inflicting them with Confuse, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Stop Chasing Me! (私を追いかけないで)
skills.description: Kawazaru throws out a handful of scattered paper to attack all enemies, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: I'd Better Hide! (急いで隠れて)
skills.description: Kawazaru opens up her double umbrella to protect all allies, creating a shield for them that can absorb 62% of Kawazaru's ATK, lasts for 2 turns.

bio.condition: Collect 8 Kawazaru shards from Demon Parade.
Fight with Kawazaru in Realm Raid 30 times.
